Keep original framing, not a centered inventory icon. The near hand grips the wooden shaft at (749,573); draw its vertical/slightly tilted shaft from about (742,490) THROUGH (749,573), ending inside the pot around (780,720). The far hand at (955,666) supports the pot rim/side, so the pot's upper-right edge must pass beneath that hand. Pot opening ellipse approximately x765..1000,y635..715, bottom around y815. Modest household pot about 230 pixels wide, a fifth of this resident's full height, same visual scale as the original reference. Broad soft painted grey metal shading, subdued warm upper-left highlights, rounded rim, simple wood grain, no glossy chrome or ornate handles. Visible simple warm food surface in the opening, spoon bowl naturally hidden inside. True transparency outside and through gaps. Preserve all canvas space above and left; keep entire equipment silhouette inside margins. Output only the equipment; original resident body will be composited unchanged.
